sources.title: Meta and Microsoft Introduce the Next Generation of Llama
sources.evidence: Dated July 18, 2023; announces Llama 2 availability, including pretrained and conversational weights and starting code.

sources.title: Llama-2-13b-hf official model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Exact official repository identifies the 13B pretrained model converted to Transformers, explicitly distinct from the dialogue-tuned Llama-2-Chat models. Its Params column gives 13B, with 4k context and no GQA; the card identifies Meta and text-only input/output.

sources.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026, and checked the fresh original-paper cache. Sections 1–2 distinguish pretrained Llama 2 from Llama 2-Chat and Llama 1; Table 1 gives the Llama 2 13B row 13B parameters, 4k context and no GQA. Section 2.2 describes RMSNorm, SwiGLU and RoPE. Section 5.1 tool-use experiments concern Llama 2-Chat. No separate active-count specification is given for this model.

sources.title: Llama 2 Community License Agreement in the exact 13B repository
sources.evidence: Public file names the Llama 2 Community License Agreement and July 18, 2023 version release. Grants conditional use and redistribution, incorporates use restrictions, and requires additional permission above its 700-million-user threshold.

sources.title: Meta Llama 2 reference repository README, llama_v2 branch
sources.evidence: Lists 13B among released models, specifies support up to 4096 tokens, and explains that pretrained models are continuation models without chat/Q&A tuning. Downloads require license acceptance and approval.

sources.title: Meta Llama 2 reference Transformer implementation, llama_v2 branch
sources.evidence: Implements causal Transformer blocks with attention, dense SwiGLU feed-forward matrices, RMSNorm and rotary embeddings, with no expert router. Rotary frequencies and KV caches are computed state rather than learned parameters.

sources.title: Exact original 13B Hugging Face configuration (access restricted)
sources.evidence: The exact config blob returned HTTP 401; raw config was also inaccessible. No credentials, third-party replacement config, or gate bypass were used.

sources.title: Public metadata for the official Llama-2-13b-hf repository
sources.evidence: Public API identifies manual gating and LlamaForCausalLM. Safetensors summary totals 13,015,866,880 stored elements (13,015,864,320 F16; 2,560 F32), without per-tensor names sufficient to establish a complete learned-parameter count.

sources.title: Mixtral of Experts, Table 2 and Sections 2.1–4
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The original January 8, 2024 report explicitly lists LLaMA 2 13B with 13B in Table 2’s Active Params column. Section 3 compares pretrained models using the authors’ evaluation pipeline; instruction fine-tuning and chat comparisons are treated separately in Section 4, which names chat variants explicitly. Section 2.1 defines active count as parameters used to process an individual token. Adopt the table’s nominal 13B benchmark convention for the exactly identified Llama 2 13B base model, attributed to Mistral rather than Meta; this is not a tensor-exact activation census.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V2 technical report, Figure 1(a)
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 and visually checked Figure 1(a), whose source is https://arxiv.org/html/2405.04434v1/mmlu.svg. The exact LLaMA 2 13B label is plotted near 13 on the Activated Parameters (Billions) axis. This independently corroborates Mistral’s nominal 13B benchmark convention at approximate plot precision; it does not provide an exact count or a Meta disclosure.

name.note: Exact official repository is the 13B pretrained base variant, distinct from Llama 2-Chat and first-generation LLaMA.

developer.note: Model card explicitly identifies Meta as developer.

family.note: Normalized identifier for the explicitly named Llama 2 family.

release_date.note: Public release announcement and license version date agree; gated individual weight approval is not a separate model release date.

open_weights.note: Weights were released with approval and license conditions. True describes weight availability, not unrestricted access or an open-source license classification.

license.note: Bespoke commercial license with use and distribution conditions; not Apache/MIT or the original LLaMA research license.

parameters_b.note: Freshly reconfirmed Meta’s published nominal 13B size for the exact pretrained base model. This supported specification does not require an exact tensor census; no more precise total is asserted.

active_parameters_b.note: Mistral’s original Mixtral paper Table 2 explicitly reports 13B Active Params for the Llama 2 13B base comparison. Adopt its nominal active-count convention, corroborated approximately by DeepSeek-V2 Figure 1(a). The count is attributed to the publishing research teams, not a separate Meta specification, and does not establish exact per-token tensor participation.

architecture.note: Dense causal Transformer with SwiGLU, RMSNorm and RoPE; the exact 13B row excludes GQA, supporting standard multi-head attention. No mixture-of-experts routing appears in the reference implementation.

context_window.note: Original trained context is 4k; Meta reference documentation gives the exact 4096-token limit. Runtime cache defaults and later context extensions do not change it.

modalities.note: The exact card explicitly limits input and output to text; downstream multimodal adaptations are outside this checkpoint.

reasoning.note: Reasoning benchmark scores and prompted step-by-step completions do not document a dedicated thinking mode for this pretrained checkpoint.

tool_call.note: Native structured tool calling is not documented for the base checkpoint. The paper's emergent calculator/tool experiment concerns Llama 2-Chat, and wrappers are not checkpoint capabilities.

description.value: Meta's Llama 2 13B pretrained text-generation model, using a dense autoregressive Transformer with multi-head attention and a 4,096-token context.
description.note: Clarifies the base variant and its supported architecture and original context without transferring Chat fine-tuning claims.

patch.description: Meta's Llama 2 13B pretrained text-generation model, using a dense autoregressive Transformer with multi-head attention and a 4,096-token context.
patch.notes: Total size is Meta’s nominal 13B. Active size is nominally 13B under Mistral’s Mixtral benchmark convention, corroborated approximately by DeepSeek; neither is a tensor-exact count. The original base model uses multi-head attention and a 4096-token context. Released weights require approval and the Llama 2 Community License. Dedicated thinking and native tool calling are not documented for this base checkpoint.

sources.label: Mistral comparison: nominal active parameters, Table 2

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit confirms Meta’s nominal 13B total for the exact Llama 2 13B pretrained base model. Resolves the previously undisclosed active count to nominal 13B using Mistral’s original Mixtral Table 2, with approximate corroboration from DeepSeek-V2 Figure 1(a); this is the comparison teams’ published convention, not a separate Meta disclosure or tensor-exact count. The other twelve assessments are unchanged; dedicated reasoning and native tool-call flags remain undisclosed.
